card.name: The word oral before drug names
card.fires_on: The word "oral" (capitalized or not) when it introduces a drug or drug class, such as contraceptives, corticosteroids, anticoagulants or tablets. It often follows "of", "with" or "from".

modes.label: Oral contraceptives
modes.description: "Oral" right before the word contraceptive(s), including at the start of a sentence.
modes.example: with the use of<< oral>> contraceptives. Oral contraceptives

modes.label: Oral other drugs
modes.description: "Oral" before another drug, drug class or dose form.

card.writes: It favors contraceptive and piece-like nouns that could follow "oral", and suppresses unrelated tokens.
card.plain: It marks the word "oral" when it is about to name a medicine, especially birth control pills.
